text:
Sasha: Hey team — following the last outage, I want to propose a tighter follow-up cadence and a clear IC rotation plan so remediations don't stall. Thoughts?
Kevin: +1. We lost momentum after T+7 last time. A concrete timeline would help.
Maria: What do you have in mind for the timeline? quick check-ins vs formal reviews?
Sasha: Draft idea: T0 = incident declared. T+24 = initial follow-up (owner assigned, quick RCA draft). T+72 = remediation plan + owners + ETA. T+14 = verification and docs. T+30 = closure review and recurrence analysis.
Aj: I like that. Can we add an automated reminder at T+72 and T+14 so items don't get missed? OpsTracker can ping the channel.
incident-bot: OpsTracker scheduled reminders enabled: T+24, T+72, T+14, T+30. Will post ownership status and outstanding items.
Priya: For IC rotation: rotate monthly among on-call leads; if someone is out, fallback to previous on-call. Also require IC handoff notes posted in thread with a short template: summary, decisions, blockers.
Kevin: Can we put the template inline? e.g.
```
IC Handoff Template:
- Outgoing IC: name
- Incoming IC: name
- Current state: short bullets
- Open action items: owner + ETA
- Next check-in: datetime
```
Sasha: Perfect. Also, assign a remediation owner distinct from the IC — that person is accountable for the fix and timeline. IC just coordinates initially.
Maria: Agree. For recurring incidents, add a "pattern review" flag at T+30 so Research/Infra can tag if similar signatures exist across logs.
Aj: Suggestion: weekly remediation sync (15m) for all actions older than 7 days. Optional to speed up closure.
Priya: For external comms: keep status updates until T+72, then one consolidated postmortem summary after closure. Legal/commms should be cc'd for regulated customers.
Sasha: I'll draft a concise one-pager with the timeline, IC rotation table, reminder automation, and the acceptance criteria for closing an action (owner confirmed, test evidence attached, doc updated). Will drop it in #eng-oncall for feedback tomorrow.
Kevin: If you add a small SLA for remediations (e.g., P1 fixes acknowledged in 72h, mitigation in 7d), that helps set expectations.
Sasha: Good call. I'll add suggested SLAs but mark them as recommendations for the first 90 days.
Maria: Quick ask — can OpsTracker create a shared board view filtered by incident tag so owners can see all outstanding items in one place?
incident-bot: OpsTracker: created board "Incident Remediations" and synced backlog for incidents tagged #1869 and newer.
Sasha: Great. Thanks everyone. I'll post the draft timeline + IC rotation doc by EOD tomorrow. If anyone wants to be on a pilot rota for next month, reply here.
Aj: I'll join pilot.
Priya: me too.
Kevin: Count me in.
Sasha: Awesome — that should give us 3 people for the first rotation.
